name: civicresolve-ai
description: CivicResolve-AI — an AI-based single window to lodge and track citizen grievances across multiple departments (PS #343). Route it right · Track it live · Prove it's fixed.

scripts.db:setup: bash scripts/db.sh up && npm --workspace server run prisma:generate && npm --workspace server run prisma:migrate && npm --workspace server run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --workspace server run dev" "npm --workspace client run dev"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,electron -c blue,magenta,green "npm --workspace server run dev" "npm --workspace client run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
